panels.body: It’s not easy being this rooted and still this interesting. Wishing you a year that’s less about repotting stress and more about steady, sun-dappled growth.

panels.headline: P.S. You’re doing great
panels.body: Also, your plant hasn’t died yet, so clearly you’ve got this adulting thing mostly under control. Wishing you slow sips of tea, good light, and zero overwatering emergencies. Hope your day feels as quietly joyful as a new unfurling leaf.
